name: STUDDS ACCESSORIES LTD
summary: Studds Accessories Limited designs, manufactures, markets, and sells helmets. It also provides other accessories, such as two-wheeler luggage, gloves, helmet locking devices, rain suits, riding jackets, and eye wear. It operates in Americas, Asia, Europe, and rest of the world. The company was founded in 1973 and is based in Faridabad, India.
